name: Todoist
description: Todoist is a task and project management app that lets individuals and teams capture, organize, schedule, and track to-do items, with support for recurring tasks, labels, and shared projects.
best_for: Vendor language positions it for both individual task and time management and team collaboration, citing tens of thousands of teams using it to organize work together.
features: Multiple views: list, calendar, and board
Projects, sections, sub-tasks, priorities, and labels
Shared team projects with assignment and comments
Built-in AI assistant for turning tasks into action plans

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.description: A work-management platform focused on projects, tasks, timelines, and team coordination.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing more structured, cross-functional project tracking

alternatives.name: Trello
alternatives.description: A visual task-organization tool built around boards, lists, and cards.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that prefer a visual, board-based workflow

alternatives.name: ClickUp

alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a more feature-dense, all-in-one workspace
